meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For **oily skin in India under ₹500**, buy **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser**—it’s a gentle foaming, pH-balanced option designed for oily and acne-prone skin, and is listed around **₹323 for 118 ml**.[1][3]

| Product | Approx. price | Best for |
|---|---:|---|
| **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser** | ₹220–₹323 | Best overall; sensitive or oily skin[1][3] |
| **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Face Wash** | ₹415 | Oily, acne-prone skin; salicylic acid and niacinamide[10] |
| **Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** | ₹348 for 2 | Frequent breakouts and clogged pores[8] |
| **Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash** | ₹172 | Budget daily cleanser[10] |

**Recommendation:** Choose Cetaphil for everyday use. Choose The Derma Co or Dot & Key only if you regularly get pimples or blackheads, since salicylic-acid cleansers can be drying.

Use face wash **twice daily maximum**, avoid scrubbing, and apply a lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturiser afterward.[7] Prices vary by seller and discounts.
